title: Universal attainability of the two-round MEDP bound
summary: Decide whether every admissible S-box and width admits a field-linear MDS diffusion layer attaining the source upper bound on two-round MEDP.

formal_statement.body: For every permutation $S$ of $\mathbb F_{2^m}$ and every admissible width $t$, does there exist an $\mathbb F_{2^m}$-linear MDS matrix $M$ such that $\operatorname{MEDP}_2(S,M)=2^{-m(t+1)}\max_{\mu} B(\mu)$, with $B$ as defined in the source? Construct such an $M$ for every pair $(S,t)$, characterize all admitting pairs, or give a counterexample.

scope.domain: Two-round expected differential probability of AES-like substitution-permutation networks.
assumptions: The source Theorem 2 differential definitions apply.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Bound attainment is proved for strict subclasses, including APN S-boxes over $\mathbb F_8$, but universal attainability or a complete characterization is open.

citations.label: Canteaut--Roue, affine-equivalent S-box behavior
citations.locator: Section 3.2, printed pp. 10-12; Conclusion, printed p. 20

progress.summary: The source asks whether an MDS diffusion layer can attain its two-round MEDP upper bound for every admissible S-box and width.
A later analysis proves bound attainment for a strict APN-over-$\mathbb F_8$ subclass and related sufficient families.
